summary: Reasons step by step before answering
description: Thinks step by step in a <think> block before answering math. d12 (286M params) pretrained at home on an RTX 3060, then chat fine-tuned with its identity plus 240K worked math problems (SFT step 1038). GSM8K 14.6%.

summary: Think, sharpened on math by RL
description: WesleyGPT-Think after 50 steps of reinforcement learning on grade-school math, rewarded only for a correct final answer. Thinks in a <think> block like Think. GSM8K 16.9% (Think 14.6%).

Experimental. Think's training plus 100K long conversations stitched from chats, math and quiz questions, 70% of them with later questions that depend on earlier turns (SFT step 1306). Best at math of any WesleyGPT, and stays sharp deep into a conversation: GSM8K 17.2%, and 15-18% after ~8 earlier turns (Think 5%). Remembers common facts you tell it (your name, car, job), but for other kinds it often wrongly says you haven't told it yet. ChatCORE 0.119 (Think 0.125).
Knows it is WesleyGPT. d12 chat fine-tuned with its own identity mixed in (SFT step 934).
The first chat model: d12 fine-tuned on general conversations, multiple choice and math, with no identity (SFT step 934). It doesn't know its name.
The pretrained base model, before any chat training (step 2520). It is not a chatbot: it continues whatever text you send.
